WITH line_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    CASE WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0 
         THEN derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost 
         ELSE NULL 
    END as line_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
),
invoice_cost_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(line_ratio) as invoice_cost_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as line_count
  FROM line_ratios
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_cost_ratio) as avg_invoice_ratio
  FROM invoice_cost_ratios
  WHERE invoice_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  icr.invoice_number,
  icr.invoice_cost_ratio,
  icr.line_count,
  icr.invoice_cost_ratio / oa.avg_invoice_ratio as relative_ratio
FROM invoice_cost_ratios icr
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE oa.avg_invoice_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (icr.invoice_cost_ratio / oa.avg_invoice_ratio) IS NULL, 
         icr.invoice_cost_ratio / oa.avg_invoice_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
